leverage.exposure: No leverage is open and none is recommended. The balance is positive, the recommended action is a sale rather than a purchase, so it moves the balance further from the danger line rather than towards it. The only route to a negative position this cycle would have been buying into the board, and every such route was priced and rejected. Nothing needs unwinding before the lock.

binding_gap: There is no positional hole. The squad fills three legal shapes and the eleven is complete, so nothing is binding in the structural sense. The binding constraint is instead the placement itself: the currently fielded eleven is not the best eleven available from the players already owned, and that gap costs points every hour it stands, at no cost to close. Behind it sits the real ceiling on ambition — the number of sales available is capped by squad size above the eleven-man floor, which is one, not by what the spending-power figure suggests.

verdict.detail: Nothing has moved since the last run, and the top move is unchanged and still not executed: set the lineup to 5-3-2, which brings Bernardo in and drops Amoako and keeps Widmer as the fifth defender, and only THEN sell Amoako. That order is not a preference, it is a penalty trap — after the sale the squad is eleven and every man must be placed, so selling first while Bernardo is still unplaced leaves ten in the eleven. The fix is free points and needs no cash. The board produced exactly one new listing in the last two hours and it is a reject, so there is no buy this cycle.

sell.reason: Amoako remains the one points-free sale on the books and the case has only got stronger with time. He is fit but simply not in the picture at Hamburg — the probable XI has him neither among the starters nor on the bench — and he is bleeding market value every hour with no performance floor underneath it, so selling now captures nearly all of what is left. Because the optimal shape already drops him, the sale costs nothing in fielded points. Widmer and Bernardo stay put: Widmer is the last spare defensive body and selling him would force Amoako back into the eleven, while Bernardo is worth materially more in points than the extra cash he would raise, and the board offered nothing those euros could convert into. Selling any two of the three is illegal — that is ten players and a penalty.

killed_this_run.name: Fabio Vieira (11967) — and THE UNWIND-CEILING DOCTRINE that kills every big buy at 12 players
killed_this_run.why: READ THE DOCTRINE BEFORE EVER RECOMMENDING A BUY ABOVE ~4M. Vieira is the best-looking buy the board has produced and he is still a REJECT, and the reason generalises. THE PLAYER IS GENUINELY GOOD - this is not a quality rejection. Fabio Vieira (11967), HSV (tid 6, tn "Hamburg"), pos 3 MID, st 0 fit, mv 18.586.935, cv 18.500.000, mvt 0, listed by KICKBASE (no u field) at prc = mv exactly, ofc 0, dt 2026-09-03T00:39:10Z, expiry 2026-09-04T01:07Z. Signed PERMANENTLY from Arsenal on DEADLINE DAY 01.09.2026 (t-online "Transfer am Deadline Day"; bundesliga.com "Hamburg sign Fabio Vieira on permanent transfer from Arsenal"; Sky "Fabio Vieira kehrt zum HSV zurueck"). HE HAS NO 26/27 POINTS ONLY BECAUSE HE WAS STILL AN ARSENAL PLAYER ON MD1 - get_player_performance confirms ph [{hp:false}] for MD1 (Dortmund 2:0 HSV 29.08). DO NOT apply the "cheap player with no history" heuristic to him and DO NOT apply the refuted 500.000 rule: he has a FULL 25/26 Bundesliga season at HSV on loan - 29 scoring appearances, 25 starts, season ap 96, tp 2795, mean 104,8 over starts, mean 108,3 over his last 13, with 217/201/195/178/177/158/157 highs. A realistic ap is 95-115. Ligainsider HSV page (stand 01.09.2026 20:31, post-MD1) names him in the probable XI at CAM v Mainz 06.09 15:30 - AFTER the MD2 lock, so he would count. THE ARITHMETIC IS WHY HE IS AN AVOID, and it was computed by brute force over every 2-sale unwind and all eight legal shapes. Doing NOTHING and just fixing the lineup gives 5-3-2 = 1395 fielded ap for free. Buying Vieira AT MV (18.586.935) takes cash 4.037.522 to MINUS 14.549.413. The squad becomes 13, so exactly TWO sales are legal before the 11-man floor. The ONLY 2-sale combo that gets the balance back to non-negative is Bernardo + Lokonga (7.048.552 + 9.748.111 = 16.796.663 -> +2.247.250), and that leaves 11 = 1/4/4/2 fielding 1385 at ap 96 or 1399 at ap 110. So the whole operation is worth MINUS 10 to PLUS 4 points against doing nothing for free. At +10% over mv it is +388.556 balance and the same 1385-1399. At +20% (the middle of the corrected Kickbase band) NO combo except selling Minjae or Matsima clears zero and the best XI drops to 1351, strictly WORSE than 1395. Adding a second cheap buy to unlock a third sale was also priced: Vieira + Ndiaye then selling Bernardo+Lokonga+Widmer gives 1370. Also worse. THE DOCTRINE, which is the durable part: SPENDING POWER IS AN ILLUSION AT 12 PLAYERS. kb_context prints spending power 54.721.905 and that number is real for the 33% floor, but it is NOT purchasing capacity, because CASH is only 4.037.522 and a negative balance at matchday start scores ZERO for the whole matchday. Every euro above cash must be earned back by SALES before the lock, and the number of sales is capped at (squad size - 11), not by what he owns. At 12 players that is ONE sale; at 13 after a buy it is TWO. His only points-free bodies are Amoako (1.709.447) and Widmer (1.853.282), so his TRUE buying capacity without touching the fielded eleven is about 4.037.522 + 1.709.447 + 1.853.282 = 7.600.251. Anything above that is paid for in fielded points, and the points a big buy adds are handed straight back by the players he must sell to unwind. THE TEST A FUTURE RUN MUST RUN BEFORE RECOMMENDING ANY BUY: price the FULLY UNWOUND end state (balance >= 0, squad >= 11, best legal XI) against the do-nothing optimum. If it does not beat it by a clear margin, it is an AVOID no matter how good the player is. HOW VIEIRA COULD BECOME A BUY: only once the squad has genuine spare bodies - 13+ players of which 2+ are droppable - or once cash is above ~15M. Neither is reachable before the 2026-09-04T18:30Z lock. ALSO AVOIDED THIS RUN, same board sweep: Moussa Ndiaye (13449), Werder DEF, mv 1.870.307, Kickbase listing at mv, expiry 2026-09-03T20:42Z, no points history and no dated news - a 12th-body candidate only, and Georg already has the 12th body he is trying to sell. NOTE ON ofc: Vieira showed ofc 0, but the listing was SIX MINUTES old at the read. A brand-new listing with ofc 0 is uninformative - the corrected ofc rule in HOLD Hntz0sp only applies to a listing that has been up long enough to attract offers. Do not cite his ofc 0 as evidence he was uncontested.
